# Copilot instructions

Project: Brand assets, design tokens, UI mockups and guidelines (no application code).

Full cross-tool rules: `.ai/rules/project.md` (read it first).

## Essentials

- Write all code, comments, commit messages and documentation in English.
- Fix every error you meet, also outside the request.
- Never add dependencies or secrets; follow the sibling files of the area you change.
- Never change a logo, color or design token unless the owner asks: other projects depend on them.
- Keep binary files small (optimized SVG/PNG/WebP) and named consistently with the existing folders.
- Guidelines in `guidelines/` and `docs/` are the reference: keep them in sync with the assets.

## Commands

- No build step.
